operating_point.objective: maximum precision; retain at least95% of baseline-correct GT identities; select on TRAIN only

evaluation.normalization: Unicode casefold; remove Unicode punctuation and symbols; preserve accents digits whitespace
evaluation.aggregation: micro over all care GT; unmatched outputs count against precision; empty outputs have precision0
evaluation.ignore: inherit frozen source care-only ground_truth; no failed image dropped

parameter_selection: Predeclare seven admission families and20 thresholds before any new BERT scores; choose operating points only on reused TRAIN. No TEST tuning or strict promotion. Final configuration-only revision exposes the original fixed anchor length2/IoU.5 and removes all implicit policy defaults. All numeric decisions remain exactly unchanged; no outcome-driven tuning. Verified historical BERT cache may be replayed only with identical observable samples and unchanged scoring function/masking/model identity.

scientific_choices.rationale: Paper sections3.3-3.5 specify padded component crops, PARSeq-S and scene descriptions; they do not specify BERT crop selection or cross-threshold groups.
scientific_choices.expected_effect: New component is approximate extension only.

scientific_choices.rationale: Reuse original many-crop readings and guarded/consolidated crop groups, checksum verified; no extra OCR or generated spellings.
scientific_choices.expected_effect: Same candidate geometry/readings and baseline; one crop per group and one use per original crop.

scientific_choices.rationale: KEEP plus up to2 distinct native readings, bboxIoU>=.5, robust visual ratio>=.85. Frozen reliable PARSeq anchors require confidence>=.85, maskmean>=.4 and at least2 normalized characters; exclude target and shared parent groups. Same geometry-derived context for every alternative; pinned fallible Florence caption in a separate BERT segment.
scientific_choices.expected_effect: Protects crop geometry and resists self-confirmation; may exclude a correct low-confidence crop.

scientific_choices.rationale: log robust visual score ratio +.15 times target-only mean PLL-word-l2r delta; gain>.1, tiesKEEP. Crop collisions revert all involved groups to baseline.
scientific_choices.expected_effect: Training-free BERT reranking; no calibrated confidence claim.

scientific_choices.rationale: Geometric mean of native confidence, absolute averaged-mask mean and clipped height-in-mask-cells/2. Joint score multiplies visual by sigmoid((BERT PLL+6)/2)^.25. Unknown/overlong BERT targets abstain to visual score. Confidence-only, visual-only, local and Florence joint controls isolate effects. No dictionary/mixed-case/numeric rejection.
scientific_choices.expected_effect: May reduce false positives; language can reject real names/numbers and favor fluent hallucinations.

scientific_choices.rationale: Retain all983 care GT under inherited local metric. Fixed grid0:.05:.95; maximize precision while retaining>=95% of baseline-correct GT identities. Report all operating points, recovered/lost and counts. Selection on TRAIN is development, not independent validation.
scientific_choices.expected_effect: Explicit high-recall tradeoff and fair language-versus-visual ablation.

scientific_choices.rationale: CPU FP32 BERT in a separate process, fourthreads, batch16; reuse original PARSeq/masks and cached Florence captions. Explicit optional singleCUDA process, no automatic fallback.
scientific_choices.expected_effect: RTX3070 VRAM and GPU outputs remain unqualified; this is not paper timing.

scientific_choices.rationale: Generic pretrained BERT is not a text/background detector. Independent transfer, official polygon protocol, calibration, novel crop generators and the80-90% target remain unresolved.
scientific_choices.expected_effect: Do not promise target precision or recall without measured evidence.
